name: Ruby
overview: Scripture uses the ruby as a symbol of great value and beauty, emphasizing that wisdom and virtuous character surpass even the finest treasures. Job 28:18 highlights that wisdom's worth exceeds that of rubies, while Proverbs 20:15 contrasts abundant rubies with the preciousness of knowledge. Proverbs 31:10 further elevates the virtuous woman’s worth above rubies, and Lamentations 4:7 employs the ruby's rich color to describe purity and strength. Together, these verses teach that spiritual and moral excellence are more precious than material riches.
